$comment: Pinned third-party binaries fetched at build time by thirdparty.ps1.
They are NOT committed: rclone.exe is ~60 MB and the WinFsp MSI is ~2 MB,
and neither belongs in a source repository.
sha256 is the SHA256 of the downloaded artefact, lower-case hex.
An empty sha256 means 'not yet pinned': the build still succeeds, but it
prints a loud warning containing the hash it actually saw, so a human can
paste it in here once, from a machine with network access. See
